messages.subject: Project Yarrow — LTSA draft from Halstead's side
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Further to the heads of terms, please find our first draft of the long-term supply agreement (we'll send under separate cover via the data site). We've worked to the agreed commercial framework. We'd welcome your mark-up; we're keen to keep momentum and target signature in January, ahead of first-article inspection.

Glad to set up a call once your team has been through it.

Kind regards,
James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
